entries.name: eyes01
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / faithful illustration restoration. Asset: ONE isolated male facial component, genuinely transparent RGBA, newly painted to faithfully match the supplied reference drawing, not a new design. Fine hand-painted ink and pale watercolor, matching the reference's restrained warm earthy colors. No labels, panels or guide marks. No background, no opaque peach rectangular or oval skin patch. Preserve fine antialiased strokes and localized natural translucent warm shading.
Input shows the original male's brow/eye region enlarged. Repaint ONLY the pair of eyes, preserving exactly the same calm long almond eye shapes, natural asymmetric inner/outer corners, small brown iris, upper lid covering the iris top and very subtle thin lower eyelid. The slightly narrower, composed eyes must look like the original reference. Upper ink edge is dark brown and delicately varied, not a thick eyeliner wing. Sclera is warm off-white, with no bright white glow. Natural subtle iris catchlight. No round doll eyes, blue/green pupils, heavy lashes, dark under-eye bags or heavy lid shadows. Remove the brows, hairs and all other face components. Only the pair of eyes including their faint eyelid creases remains. Draw the two eyes together in their original relative spacing; never move one eye independently. Transparent space around and between the two eye drawings. Keep the eye pair fairly large for a detailed source drawing, horizontal frontal alignment.

Input is the original male's lower face enlarged. Repaint ONLY his same closed, relaxed, thin natural male lips with the same silhouette and horizontal understated mouth seam. Match the original gray-beige/soft muted dusty-peach pigment, thin upper lip, modest lower lip and tiny restrained two-point highlight. Do not make lips fuller or more orange, red or glossy; no lipstick, no pout, no smiling upturn or cupid-bow exaggeration. Only the lips, corners and extremely faint nearby warm watercolor transition are visible; no nose, chin outline, face patch or skin rectangle. Keep the reference's thin, quiet male mouth, rather than idealizing it. One isolated mouth on real transparency.

entries.name: nose01
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / faithful illustration restoration. Asset: ONE isolated male facial component, genuinely transparent RGBA, newly painted to faithfully match the supplied reference drawing, not a new design. Fine hand-painted ink and pale watercolor, matching the reference's restrained warm earthy colors. No labels, panels or guide marks. No background, no opaque peach rectangular or oval skin patch. Preserve fine antialiased strokes and localized natural translucent warm shading.
Input is the restored complete male master. Newly paint ONLY his full nose component: the very faint nasal root shading between inner brows (nasion), delicate straight upper bridge, nose tip, two nasal wings and both nostrils, all in one layer. Faithfully match the reference anatomy: moderate width, subtle flattened wing/tip contour, visible but soft rounded alae and small brown nostrils. The alae MUST exist even though their edges are subtle. No round button nose, raised white nose plate, heavy U outline around tip, broad opaque face strip, or ghost eyebrows/eyes/mouth. Nasal root is a faint warm-gray-peach wash fading to actual transparency on all sides, central bridge largely unpainted so underlying skin shows through. Nose tip and alae have only localized warm watercolor skin pigment matching the master; understated tiny highlight, not glossy or chalk-white. Preserve the reference's natural proportion between the full long faint bridge and the small lower nose. Draw the nose on genuine transparency only, with no fake checkerboard or pale mist elsewhere.
